actual_extra_qualification: Compare both corrected Cargo and Rust source branches to the hosted pins before submitting them. Keep the demonstrated correction of prior incorrect binary/check outputs separate from the steady-state time endpoints.
amendment: A real external crate reached through an ASCII symlink can have a non-Unicode canonical path. Two distinct compiler inputs then render as the same Make name if a second real directory contains a literal U+FFFD. Before any ordinary wall clock on the original matched pair, the released compiler and the first corrected prototype produced an ambiguous checksum. The revised compiler withholds a digest for the entire colliding key in either input order. The revised Cargo rejects the unpublished v3 record and distrusts old unescaped or lossy checksum names unless the new compiler v2 marker is present. Carry forward the identical pair assignments, clocks, seeds, workflows, host, stopping criteria and statistics. Retain the previous source and all functional observations. Never combine subjects or promote any previous run to this timing cohort.
clock: On the dedicated host, run one fresh private copy of each trained state, preserving logical paths. After confirming all original ELF digests on those copies, prime once per arm with ordinary Cargo JSON, outside the clock. Run 24 adjacent pairs per workflow in the registered balanced order. Preserve each command stdout, stderr, monotonic nanoseconds and exit status. After each clock, hash all native files and list the selected test executable. Verify the full unit roster, diagnostics and expected dirty set once more at the end. Do not run test bodies. The acquisition runs under an exclusive lock with the same CPU affinity and jobs. No wrapper, tracer or Cargo JSON in scored commands.

controls.package: cargo +ohm test --no-run -p ty_project --locked --offline -j4, with ruff target and Ohm-SDK
controls.workspace: cargo +ohm test --no-run --workspace --locked --offline -j4, with ruff-target and Ohm SDK

gate: Require unchanged Ruff source and index. Before any clock in either workflow require both matched native qualifications to finish successfully. Each parent must reproduce the repeated released rustc and Wild counts twice; each candidate must be fully fresh with zero compiler and Wild processes twice. Verify identical unit/target/profile/feature/output roster, exact diagnostics, exact selected harness listing, and all 4 or 110 native files. Allow equivalence across different real links only when all ELF bytes outside the GNU build ID and .rodata sh_entsize agree. Check original workspaces again after the clock. If an integrity check fails, preserve the failure and withhold scores.
profile: Use the matching compiler frontend/driver pair and a fixed standard library. Bind exact Cargo, compiler frontend, driver, linker, source patch, and native qualification manifests before opening times. Require candidate profile coverage at least 95% of matched parent profiled-function count, at least 95% of its BOLT covered sample weight, and no more than two percentage points extra stale profile weight. Retain the full original BOLT diagnostics and unoptimized version of the helper as a separate excluded experiment.
safety_gate: Before any clock, require direct native fixed-compiler regression with both external input orders and a lone valid replacement-character positive control, original genuine wrong-output and invalid-check controls for spaced inputs, verified conservative migration from the published cache, and native FIFO handling. Bind source inputs, BOLT coverage, normal toolchain identity, and raw correctness receipts before opening wall time.
scope: New cold states separately built and trained for each source arm and workflow, then consecutive unchanged local development commands. Includes the rustup dispatch and the entire Cargo subprocess. Compare source edits on the canceled RC17 release inputs with the same donor PGO, BOLT, standard library, compiler version stamp and Wild. These source experiments are distinct from a packaged 1.99.0-17 and do not estimate upgrade or clean-build wall time.
statistics: Always report both endpoints. Per endpoint report medians, paired geometric-mean percent reduction, a two-sided exact test of all 2,704,156 balanced slot assignments, 100,000 paired fixed-seed bootstrap resamples and the fraction favorable. Adjust the two p-values using Holm. Claim a benefit only at Holm p < 0.05, 95% interval lower bound > 1%, and at least two thirds favorable. Withhold a broad claim in the presence of a significant material regression in the other endpoint. No interim estimates, outlier deletions or stopping on a time. An infrastructure failure remains part of the record.
